nodes.name: From Module 2.6 (Payment Received)
nodes.notes: Module 2.6 ke 'Postgres - Mark Paid' step ke baad ye workflow Execute Workflow se call hona chahiye, input me { odoo_lead_id } aata hai. (2.6/workflow.json me is call ko wire karna abhi baaki hai -- README dekho.)

parameters.query: SELECT * FROM clients_master WHERE odoo_lead_id = {{$json.odoo_lead_id}} LIMIT 1;

nodes.name: Nextcloud - Create Client Folder
nodes.notes: neverError=true kyunki agar folder pehle se exist karta hai to Nextcloud 405 dega -- wo ignore karna hai, blocker nahi hai.

nodes.name: Nextcloud - Create Client Share Link
nodes.notes: Ye link client ko welcome email me diya jaayega, aur delivery team bhi isi folder me deliverables daalegi.

nodes.name: Build Onboarding Task List
nodes.notes: v1 fixed 6-task template hai. v2: service_type ke hisaab se alag templates (SEO vs Design vs VA) Postgres table se pull karo.

nodes.name: Odoo - Create Onboarding Tasks (batch)
nodes.notes: Odoo 17+ ka create() method dicts ki list accept karke ids ki list return karta hai. Agar aapka Odoo version isse support na kare, to har task ke liye alag create call (loop) karna hoga -- Known Limitations dekho.

nodes.name: Odoo - Create Client Discuss Channel
nodes.notes: Kuch Odoo versions me model 'discuss.channel' hai (mail.channel purane versions me). Apne Odoo version ke hisaab se model name confirm/adjust karo.

nodes.name: Odoo - Add Delivery Team to Channel
nodes.notes: ODOO_DELIVERY_TEAM_PARTNER_IDS = comma-separated Odoo partner IDs array string e.g. [12,15,18] -- delivery/account-management team jo har client channel me by-default honi chahiye.

parameters.subject: =Welcome to Nivy, {{$json.name}}! Here's what happens next
parameters.text:
=Hi {{$json.name}},

Welcome aboard! Your project is now set up and our delivery team has been notified.

Your shared folder (assets, deliverables, reports will live here): {{$json.client_folder_url}}

Over the next few days we'll reach out to schedule a kickoff call and collect access/brand assets. If anything's urgent, just reply to this email.

Excited to get started!
Team Nivy

parameters.query:
UPDATE clients_master
SET status = 'Onboarded',
    nextcloud_folder_url = {{JSON.stringify($json.client_folder_url)}},
    odoo_project_id = {{$json.odoo_project_id}},
    odoo_discuss_channel_id = {{$json.odoo_discuss_channel_id}},
    updated_at = now()
WHERE odoo_lead_id = {{$json.odoo_lead_id}};

main.node: Odoo - Add Delivery Team to Channel
